## Coming soon

This case study will describe pricing-model development for CPG in the U.S. across thousands of products and 18 categories.

The work covered price-sensitivity models, cross-price models, promotional versus non-promotional splits, and optimization frontiers linking expected prices with quantities. It also helped reduce the category pricing cycle from four months to two weeks.

The full case will focus on the analytical framework, operating process and decision logic without disclosing confidential client data.
